title: PCAOB Spotlight — 2023 Inspection Activities Staff Update
description: PCAOB staff spotlight (August 2024) summarizing 2023 inspections across firms. Tailored to this specific report.

title.description: Document title as printed on the cover.

publication_month.description: Publication month printed on the cover (e.g. 'August 2024').

inspection_year_covered.description: Calendar year whose inspection activities are summarized.

represents_board_position.description: True if the cover states the document represents the views of the Board (vs. staff).

section_titles.description: Top-level section titles from the Table of Contents, in order.

first_time_firms_inspected_counts.description: Number of firms inspected for the first time, by year, as stated in the Trends section.

firm_inspection_cadence_buckets.description: Every inspection-cadence bucket described in the firm classification section (annual vs triennial, affiliated vs non-affiliated, and the audit-report threshold governing each).

audit_report_threshold_condition.description: e.g. 'issues more than 100 issuer audit reports per year'.

deficiency_rate_trend_chart.description: Datapoints read off the deficiency-rate trend chart in the Key Findings / Trends section. If no chart present, empty array.

common_deficiency_themes.description: Themes enumerated in 'Common Deficiencies Found by 2023 Inspections' (Section II). One entry per audit-area heading.

example_deficiency.description: A one-sentence summary of a representative deficiency quoted in the section.

contains_independence_rules_guidance.description: True if the report includes content on SEC / PCAOB auditor-independence rules.

first_time_firms_drove_trend.description: Whether the report attributes the year-over-year deficiency rate change primarily to first-time-inspected firms. Derived from Trends narrative.

first_time_firm_yoy_increase_percent.description: Percent increase in first-time-inspected firms from 2022 to 2023, computed from the Trends figures. e.g. (28 - 19) / 19 * 100.

annual_inspection_audit_report_threshold.description: The minimum number of issuer audit reports per year that triggers annual (vs. triennial) inspection cadence. Requires reading the cadence classification section.

peak_deficiency_rate_year.description: Year in the deficiency-rate trend chart (Key Findings section) with the highest Part I.A rate. Requires chart reading.

spotlight_represents_board_position.description: Whether the cover-page disclaimer positions this document as representing the Board's views or staff views. Tests inference over the boilerplate disclaimer language.

example_deficiencies_tagged_by_audit_are.description: For each audit_area discussed in Section II's 'Common Deficiencies', the count of illustrative example deficiencies quoted under that area.

mentions_artificial_intelligence_or_mach.description: Does the report discuss AI, machine learning, or use of such tools in audit procedures? ADVERSARIAL: a 2023 inspection spotlight likely does not mention these terms.

year_over_year_part_1a_rate_trend.description: Directional trend of the Part I.A deficiency rate over the years covered in the chart. Inference from chart trajectory.

includes_broker_dealer_guidance_section.description: Whether the independence-rules section calls out broker-dealers specifically (distinct from public companies). Tests classification of section sub-scope.

firm_classification_table_rows.description: Each firm-classification bucket row from Section I describing how firms are selected and inspected. Bucket label, inspection cadence, audit-report threshold, firm-count. Tests multi-column table with narrative descriptors as cell values.

inspection_profile_information_table.description: The 'Inspection Profile Information' section usually contains a dense table of firm counts by category and year. Each row: category, 2022 count, 2023 count, change. Tests multi-year column binding.

cover_page_metadata_block.description: The cover-page 'Spotlight' metadata block: title, subtitle/year, publication month, issuing body name, disclaimer language.

table_of_contents_section_pages.description: Rows of the Table of Contents: each top-level section title plus its page number. Tests row-level binding across a dense TOC that mixes section titles with page numbers.
